catalogue_card.question: Bitget Trading Builder closes in four days. Is the $50,000 pool your pay?
catalogue_card.text: No. The issuer still lists 30 Sep 2026 as the close, but the pool is shared and partly first-come, first-served. It requires an existing trading audience or community and does not state an individual award.

summary: Bitget’s issuer page still lists 30 Sep 2026 as the Trading Builder recruitment close. It asks for 500+ social followers or a 100+ member community, plus substantial trading experience.
The work is trading-community promotion across products including spot, futures, CFDs and RWAs. This is not a general entry-level contributor role.
Its stated $50,000 promotion pool is shared; part is first-come, first-served, and the issuer does not state an individual award. Applications may be reviewed within seven working days.
